tld.purpose: Used for clearly invalid domain names.
tld.remarks:
The .invalid top-level domain is reserved for cases where a domain is purposely not meant to resolve. It's often used in technical documentation, testing, or error handling to signal a non-functional or deliberately bogus address.

For further information, see [Special-Use Domain Names](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc6761#section-6.5) (RFC 6761) and [Reserved Top Level DNS Names](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc2606) (RFC 2606).
